messages:
leo_ops: Quick heads up 2 captions lagging ~5s and we got a small frame drop at 17:30 during the roadmap slide. Stream still up. @maya can you check the recorder and OBS?

maya: Looking now. Switched OBS to low-latency profile and toggled captions to external ASR. Which recorder host?

leo_ops: record04. I see a couple partial segments in /mnt/recordings/record04/tmp.

obs-bot: obs: scene switched to backup_lowlatency at 2026-03-25T17:30:12Z. Encoder: reduced bitrate to 3.5mbps.

infra-bot: infra-alert: record04 reported transient CPU steal (1.8s) around 2026-03-25T17:30:10Z, no disk errors. Suggest pinning recorder process to isolated core.

maya: Starting rsync of written segments to s3: `aws s3 sync /mnt/recordings/record04/ s3://redwood-archives/allhands/record04/2026-03-25/ --acl team-read` 2 ETA ~2m. Will flag partials.

qa-lyn: I'll scrape chat/qa sheet for any missed audience Qs between 17:29-17:32. Noted one at 17:30 asking "how will we phase the infra improvements?" Adding to follow-ups.

stream-monitor: monitor: captions drift peaked +5.1s at 17:31, packet loss 0.9% for 3m, latency +2.0s; captions fallback active.

leo_ops: Jen, continue Q&A or pause?

jen (CEO): Continue. Keep collecting missed Qs; I'll answer top items at the end. Also cc Comms on transcripts.

maya: Upload complete. Partial segments recorded with `partial-` prefix. S3 link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-archives/allhands/record04/2026-03-25/ (team-read).

leo_ops: Action items: 1) postmortem (leo_ops) by EOD, 2) QA compile missed Qs (qa-lyn) in 30m, 3) infra to review CPU steal on record04 (eng-infra). If anyone wants to preserve local clips, paste S3 locations here. :thumbsup:
